# KORA

> KORA is the outcomes and insights platform for residential children's care, fostering, and supported settings.

KORA is made by SixByFive (https://sixbyfive.com) and is available at https://koraplatform.co.uk.

## What KORA does

KORA helps residential children's care providers:

- Record daily logs, incidents, mood, behaviour, sleep, medication, and school attendance in a structured way
- Automatically surface patterns and correlations across records (e.g. sleep → behaviour, family contact → mood)
- Generate statutory reports including LAC reviews and Ofsted-ready exports in one click
- Manage young person profiles with goals, achievements, family contact logs, and timeline views
- Maintain a full audit trail on every record for compliance and inspections

## Who KORA is for

- Care workers in residential children's homes — faster shift recording, guided incident forms
- Home managers — dashboards, alerts, oversight without manual analysis
- Organisational leaders — multi-home visibility, access controls, billing management

## Pricing

- £125/month for the first home
- £25/month per additional home
- No per-user charges, no setup fees
- 7-day free trial, no card required
- Cancel anytime; data available for export for 30 days after cancellation

## Key features

- Young person living profiles (goals, achievements, education, health, family contact)
- Shift-based daily logs with structured fields (mood, behaviour, sleep, appetite, activity)
- Incident recording with severity grading and body maps
- Medication tracking with missed-dose alerts
- School attendance and engagement recording
- Automated pattern detection across time (mood, behaviour, incidents, sleep, contact)
- Alert thresholds for managers
- One-click LAC review report generation
- Ofsted-ready exports and full audit trail
- Progress reports — per-resident reports with mood trend charts, incident breakdowns, education attendance, and auto-calculated progress rating
- CSV exports — download care records as flat files with date-range and resident filters
- Full data export — download all organisation data as a single JSON file
- Real-time staff messaging across homes with desktop notifications and unread count
- Insights — automated pattern analysis: mood trends, incident frequency, school-day correlation, sleep/behaviour correlation, family contact mood impact
- Rota — weekly staff rota with shift types (morning, afternoon, evening, night, waking night)
- Tasks — home-level task management with assignees, due dates, and priority levels
- Forms — customisable form builder and response collection for any care workflow
- Independence tracking — skill proficiency snapshots across life domains for each resident
- Handover — structured shift handover notes with flagging
- Role-based access controls (Platform Admin, Org Admin, Home Manager, Senior Staff, Care Staff, Read Only)
- Per-home data isolation — staff at one home cannot access another home's records
- UK data residency
- Offline-capable desktop app (Windows and macOS)
- GDPR-compliant (subject access requests, right to erasure, data retention policies)

## Comparison

KORA is purpose-built for residential children's care. Unlike general care management tools (e.g. Clearcare, Lief), KORA includes:
- Young person outcome tracking
- Automated insight and pattern detection
- Statutory reporting (LAC, Ofsted)
- Per-home database isolation
- UK data residency
- Offline-capable desktop app
